scope: Five actual PNG captures of production TerminalTabs and TerminalPanel widgets driven by an in-memory synthetic transport. Visual review only; no live SSH transport or platform acceptance is established by these images.
source_identity_limit: Focused executions occurred before this packaging snapshot. Their stdout does not contain an execution-time full source inventory. This snapshot must not be represented as proof of a frozen full application run.

fixture.transport: In-memory _Connection implements TerminalConnection and TerminalConnectionSharing; no socket is opened.
fixture.output: Deterministic fixture strings, including example build output and an independent shell prompt.
fonts: MaterialIcons loaded from Flutter material font asset
fixture.platform_limit: A Linux Flutter widget-test renderer with two viewport sizes; not browser runtime, a packaged desktop application or a physical mobile device.

review.method: Opened and visually inspected each original PNG individually after the successful widget cohort; copied originals without image modification.
findings: All three explicit shared SSH actions are readable at desktop and compact widths.
Independent desktop terminal output and shared-route badges are visible.
Close confirmation accurately discloses remaining shared-route ownership.
At compact width the active pane is retained and the workspace menu remains scrollable.
limits: This inspection covers English labels only; translation completeness and placeholder preservation are behavioral-test assertions, not separate locale screenshots.
The fixture font set does not qualify platform font fallback; existing auxiliary keyboard-row glyphs appear as fallback boxes in desktop captures.
Root independent visual review, full terminal cohort, optimized web build and complete source-identity checks are separate.

screenshots.review_finding: Desktop workspace menu exposes explicit shared shell and shared split actions before ordinary pane actions.
Two production terminal panels render independent fixture output and shared-route badges.
Close confirmation explains independent terminal release and the route resources retained by remaining terminals.
Compact workspace displays the active terminal, keeps the shared-route badge visible and collapses the split.
Compact scrollable workspace menu keeps all three explicit shared SSH actions visible.
